name: Rae's Solitaire
preview_alt: Gameplay of a 1-bit video version of Klondike Solitaire. The player moves some cards around in the tableau, and flips through the deck some.
short_desc: A nice Klondike for your PD
long_desc: Lately, I've been getting into solitaire. One night, I thought: "I wanna play some solitaire on my Playdate". Then I thought, "how hard would it be to make it?" ...So, I made Klondike solitaire for my Playdate! Now, you can play it on yours, too.

name: Labsylle
preview_alt: Gameplay of Labsylle. A cursor navigates along a horizontal row of syllabic blocks, swapping them around one-at-a-time to try to reach a target word.
short_desc: A words-y 'spin' on a puzzle game
long_desc: Labsylle's all about the "building blocks" of the English language. Swap around syllable blocks, two at a time, to assemble words. That's it! It'll keep you busy, too; with over 500 curated puzzles, and a whole dictionary of "Quik-Words" to experience in 60-second bursts.

name: Mission LunaTrix
preview_alt: Gameplay of Mission LunaTrix. An astronaut on a skateboard is riding on the lunar surface, ramping off of craters and performing tricks while in the air. A close-up of their legs shows off what tricks they're pulling.
long_desc: When you find yourself trapped on the surface of an unfamiliar terrain, there's only one thing that can bring you back to terra firma...EPIC SKATE TRICKS.

name: Traffic Jam
preview_alt: Gameplay of Traffic Jam. A construction worker is holding a sign with an arrow, flipping it back and forth to wave through oncoming cars from either direction.
short_desc: On your left! No, my right!
long_desc: Watch out for four distinct car types, keep the beat (as well as you can) to an increasing tempo, and try to avoid a nasty collision! Made just for Playdate.

name: Bona Fido
preview_alt: Gameplay of Bona Fido. A skeletal dog runs around a single-screen stage, barking at enemies such as turtles and crabs to knock them down. The dog is also digging up sprouts coming from the ground, collecting items.
long_desc: Narrowly dodge enemies, dig up trick-or-treatin' treasures, and bark your way to becoming top dog of the afterlife in this sp00py single-screen platformer.

name: RowBot Rally
preview_alt: Gameplay of RowBot Rally. A boat drives around a river track with flowerbeds on the sides, getting caught in whirlpools. Bugs fly overhead.
short_desc: Row for the gold and save the Fish Bowl!
long_desc: When a fleet of evil "RowBots" threaten to take over the annual boat-racing tourney, can you and a defective junkyard RowBot of your own put a stop to the Shark Boss's nefarious plans?

name: HEXA
preview_alt: Gameplay of HEXA. A hexagonal cursor navigates around a grid of 19 triangles, trying to match a full hexagon of same-colored triangles. Matching them makes the timer go back up by a few seconds.
short_desc: Rule the universe, shape by shape
long_desc: Conquer the HEXAPLEX, wrangle those Power-ups, and maybe even become ruler of the universe along the way in HEXA, a triangle-matching puzzle game that's HEXA-good. With plenty of modes, mechanics, and otherworldly competition.

name: First in... Line?
preview_alt: Gameplay of First in... Line? A character walks on stage, and starts reciting Playdate button inputs as a spotlight comes down on them. They recite the line correctly, and take a bow as the audience throws roses up on-stage.
long_desc: Memorize your lines, then take to the stage and...try not to flub the lead role too hard, in this game made with Playdate's extensive suite of inputs in mind.
